stop.prompt: If this session changed files outside .spec and .cursor, run .cursor/hooks/verify-stamp.sh. When it exits non-zero, finish the current .spec task: spec.md before product code, then .cursor/tools/verify-report.py --id <id> --strict. Read only .spec/tasks/<id>/verify-report.md. Do not paste test, style, smoke, or e2e output into the chat, the spec, or verify.json. When the report has no issues, write .spec/tasks/<id>/verify.json with exit 0. Do not edit reviewer rules, the PMD ruleset, ArchUnit tests, or baseline.md to get a green run. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
